module.title: Dragons of Stormwreck Isle
module.subtitle: Starter Set
module.summary: A 1-3 level D&D adventure set on Stormwreck Isle, featuring a conflict among dragons, exploration of the island's locations, and a mixture of combat, diplomacy, and investigation.

locations.name: Stormwreck Isle
locations.description: A small island in the Forgotten Realms' Sword Coast region, site of the adventure.

locations.name: Dragon's Rest
locations.description: A tiny cloister perched on a cliff overlooking a calm harbor, serving as the home base for adventurers.

locations.name: Seagrow Caves
locations.description: Sea caves on the southwest side of Stormwreck Isle, inhabited by a colony of myconids and guarded by a fungal octopus.

locations.name: Cursed Shipwreck
locations.description: The wreck of the Compass Rose on the north side of Stormwreck Isle, spawning zombies and home to a harpy.

locations.name: Clifftop Observatory
locations.description: Ruined observatory on basalt spires at the southeastern tip of Stormwreck Isle, lair of the blue dragon wyrmling Sparkrender.

areas.name: Path and Monastic Cells
areas.description: A long path ascending the cliff with garden plots and monastic cells carved into the rock.

areas.name: Winch House
areas.description: A small building with a wooden pallet lowered to the water by a winch for carrying goods.

areas.name: Kitchen
areas.description: Simple dining area and kitchen used for preparing and sharing meals by the cloister residents.

areas.name: Library
areas.description: Spacious library with bookshelves and tables focusing on theology and history.
features: bookshelves with theology and history books

areas.name: Temple of Bahamut
areas.description: Open-air temple at the cliff’s edge, crowned by a statue of Bahamut surrounded by songbirds.
features: protective magic that boosts saving throws

areas.name: Entrance Tunnel
areas.description: A 40-foot-high tunnel flooded at high tide, with bioluminescent fungi lining the walls and a spore servant octopus guarded entrance.

areas.name: Fungus Farm
areas.description: Large cavern with forest of multicolored fungi, home to myconid sprouts and violet fungi.

areas.name: Larder
areas.description: Cavern filled with decaying vegetation where myconid sprouts work near a stirge nest.

areas.name: Circle Chamber
areas.description: Cavern with giant mushroom clusters arranged in a circle, home to adult myconids, some in a meld.
features: myconids meditating and tending the ill

areas.name: Sinensa's Sanctum
areas.description: Small cavern glowing with fungus and crystals, housing the unconscious myconid leader Sinensa.

areas.name: Crystal Cave
areas.description: Cave filled with noxious fumes and flickering orange light from a large orange crystal blocking a vent.
hazards: fire snake emerging from broken egg

areas.name: Main Deck
areas.description: Decaying ship deck covered in algae and debris, crow's nest home to a harpy.

areas.name: Forecastle
areas.description: Broken foremast and a non-functional ballista.

areas.name: Quarterdeck
areas.description: Rear deck with ship’s wheel and mast remains.

areas.name: Captain's Quarters
areas.description: Barricaded cabin with a jagged hole in the floor and presence of zombies.

areas.name: Galley
areas.description: Ship galley with headless skeleton resting against counter.

areas.name: Crew Quarters
areas.description: Cabin with bunks and personal effects including a concealed floorboard stash.

areas.name: Lower Deck
areas.description: Water-covered ship’s lower deck with crates and barrels, home to zombies and a lurking ghoul.

areas.name: Hold
areas.description: Submerged ship's hold filled with debris and sea life, contains captain’s chest with a cursed talisman.
hazards: water environment requiring swimming and suffocation rules

areas.name: Overlook
areas.description: Overgrown path to cliff edge featuring dragon statues with keyholes for a moonstone key.

areas.name: Rotunda Ruins
areas.description: Plaza with fragments of statues, astronomical sculpture, and a battle between kobolds and stirges.

areas.name: Kobold Camp
areas.description: Ruined tower connected by bridge to rotunda, inhabited by hostile kobolds.

areas.name: Isolated Study
areas.description: Cramped tower with collapsed floor and a locked, trapped journal, connected to rotunda by an energy bridge.

areas.name: Observatory Tower
areas.description: Tallest tower at 45 feet, with stained glass, star map on floor, and lair of blue dragon wyrmling Sparkrender.

areas.name: Secret Library
areas.description: Hidden archive with books and spell scrolls, containing imprisoned bronze dragon wyrmling Aidron.

npcs.name: Elder Runara
npcs.role: Leader of Dragon's Rest, disguised adult bronze dragon
npcs.motivation: Help those shaped by violence find paths to peace and reconciliation; promote coexistence between chromatic and metallic dragons
secrets: True identity as a bronze dragon
Secret lair in an undersea cave away from cloister

npcs.name: Agga
npcs.motivation: Keep kobold community organized and in line

npcs.name: Blepp
npcs.role: Kobold with sharp danger sense at Dragon's Rest
npcs.motivation: Believes in his own supernatural luck
secrets: Possesses a dagger he claims is magical (likely ordinary)

npcs.name: Kilnip
npcs.role: Kobold with terrible insomnia at Dragon's Rest

npcs.name: Laylee
npcs.role: Helpful kobold and assistant to Myla at Dragon's Rest
npcs.motivation: Assist Myla with tinkering and alchemical work
secrets: Not allowed to handle Myla's alchemical fire anymore due to incident

npcs.name: Mumpo
secrets: Stole a copper piece from Runara's hoard; Runara knows but lets him believe she doesn't

npcs.name: Myla
npcs.role: Winged kobold tinkerer at Dragon's Rest
npcs.motivation: Experiment with alchemy, engineering, and magic

npcs.name: Rix
npcs.role: Templar kobold and assistant to Runara

npcs.name: Tarak
npcs.role: Human gardener at Dragon's Rest with criminal past
npcs.motivation: Atone for past wrongs; assist with herbalism and healing
secrets: Past as a ruthless poisoner for thieves' guild
Lover killed leading to his escape
Has secret visits to sea caves for heart cap mushrooms

npcs.name: Varnoth Wender
npcs.role: Aged human mercenary general at Dragon's Rest
npcs.motivation: Seek redemption and peace in twilight of life
secrets: Has history as credible general and soldier

npcs.name: Sparkrender
npcs.role: Blue dragon wyrmling antagonist at Clifftop Observatory
npcs.motivation: Harness the magic of the island to manifest full power and bind spirits of dead dragons
secrets: Believes chromatic dragons are rightful rulers

npcs.name: Aidron
npcs.role: Bronze dragon wyrmling imprisoned at Clifftop Observatory
npcs.motivation: Oppose Sparkrender and assist the party to protect island

factions.name: Dragon's Rest
factions.goal: Promote peace, reconciliation, and enlightenment on Stormwreck Isle

factions.name: Sparkrender and Kobolds
factions.goal: Harness the ancient magic of Stormwreck Isle to empower Sparkrender and dominate the island

factions.name: Kobold Renegades
factions.goal: Prey on travelers and reject both Hope of peace and Sparkrender's rule

items.name: Boots of Elven Kind
items.description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.
effects: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks related to moving silently

items.name: Elixir of Health
items.description: When you drink this potion, it cures any disease afflicting you, and it removes the blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and poisoned conditions.
effects: Removes blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and poisoned conditions

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

items.name: Potion of Resistance
items.description: When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to one type of damage for 1 hour. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly.
effects: Resistance to one damage type for 1 hour

items.name: Spell Scroll
items.description: A spell scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. You can read and cast the spell without providing material components if it is on your class spell list.

items.name: Weapon, +1
items.description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

encounter_pool.description: Three shambling drowned sailors, animated as zombies, attack the adventurers. They move to engage in melee combat and keep fighting until defeated.
trigger_conditions: Characters arrive at Dragon's Rest beach
Characters hear splashing and moaning near the shore

encounter_pool.description: Three fume drakes guard a hot spring cove. Initially indifferent, they become hostile if characters gather mushrooms or enter the water.
trigger_conditions: Characters attempt to collect mushrooms at the hot springs
Characters enter the hot springs water

encounter_pool.description: A hostile owlbear prowls an area of the island, attacking characters who enter its territory. Characters can calm the owlbear with a nearby whistle.
trigger_conditions: Characters travel across the island and come within 5 feet of the owlbear

encounter_pool.description: A group of hostile kobolds attempt to ambush the characters, hiding among rocks and foliage. They will fight to the death unless persuaded to stand down.
trigger_conditions: Characters travel around the island by land

encounter_pool.description: A spore servant octopus lurks in the entrance tunnel to the Seagrow Caves, attacking any creature except the myconids.
trigger_conditions: Characters enter the flooded tunnel of Seagrow Caves

encounter_pool.description: Violet fungi move and attack intruders in the fungus farm area of Seagrow Caves. They can be difficult to spot among other fungi.
trigger_conditions: Characters move into the fungus farm cave area

encounter_pool.description: Six stirges emerge from a nest in the larder of Seagrow Caves and attack the characters.
trigger_conditions: Characters move more than 5 feet into the larder cave of Seagrow Caves

encounter_pool.description: Zombies and a ghoul inhabit the lower deck and captain's quarters of the shipwreck of Compass Rose, attacking any intruders.
trigger_conditions: Characters enter the shipwreck lower deck or captain's quarters

encounter_pool.description: A harpy returns to its nest in the crow's nest on the shipwreck, attempting to charm and lure characters. It can be reasoned with or fought.
trigger_conditions: Characters find the captain's chest in the hold and return to main deck

encounter_pool.description: A battle between stirges and kobolds occurs at the rotunda ruins near the Clifftop Observatory. Characters can intervene.
trigger_conditions: Characters arrive at the rotunda ruins

encounter_pool.description: The blue dragon wyrmling Sparkrender confronts the adventurers in the observatory tower. He uses lightning breath and fights until low hit points.
Sparkrender performs a ritual to bind dragon spirits in the rotunda. Characters must fight Sparkrender, possibly aided by freed Aidron.
trigger_conditions: Characters arrive at rotunda during Sparkrender's ritual

threads.description: Introduction to the D&D Starter Set: basic game components and character roles.
Adventure introduction and initial encounter with zombies.
Follow-up encounter with zombies threatening Dragon's Rest after initial arrival.
Character interactions with Dragon's Rest residents and receiving quests.
Explore Seagrow Caves to resolve myconid blight and clear blocked vent.
Investigate the wreck of Compass Rose and confront undead/zombie threat and harpy.
Explore Clifftop Observatory to confront Sparkrender and free Aidron.
